concepts.quote: The square uses 0.5 as the centre
concepts.why: It correctly applies the centre rule to this call, so the square is centred in the middle of the window, but it does not give the square's size (side 0.5).
The answer says nothing about the double type.

concepts.quote: the point uses pixels, so both are in the middle
concepts.why: This is the listed wrong rule: in the default unit square, (256, 256) is far outside the window, so nothing visible is drawn there.
It assumes pixel coordinates, but StdDraw's default coordinates are the unit square, not pixels.
